nav.sideSwitch: Switch between the employee side and the management side

approvalModeHelp.manual: Every check-in waits until an event admin approves it.
approvalModeHelp.autoApproveRoster: People on the roster get their points at once; everyone else waits for an event admin.
approvalModeHelp.autoApproveAll: Everyone gets their points the moment they check in.

checkInModeHelp.static: One link and QR code for the whole event. Good for posters and invitations.
checkInModeHelp.rotating: The code on the event admin's screen changes every 30 seconds, so a forwarded photo stops working.

login.title: Sign in
login.tagline: Join company events, collect points, pick your reward.
login.featureCheckIn: Scan the event QR code or tap your card to check in
login.featureEarn: Points land in your account once an event admin approves
login.checkInNotice: Sign in to finish checking in. You will go straight back to the event.
login.devHint: Pick a seeded account. This list only exists in development.
login.oidcButton: Sign in with your company account
login.windowsButton: Sign in with your Windows account
login.windowsHint: On a company PC this needs no password.
login.noAccount: Your account is not registered as an active employee in PointHub. Contact HR or the system administrator.
login.errorGeneric: Sign-in did not complete. Please try again.

dashboard.subtitle: Your points and what is on right now.
dashboard.noEvents: No events are open right now.
dashboard.noTransactions: No points yet. Check in at an event to earn your first.
dashboard.allAffordable: You have enough points for any gift in the catalog.
dashboard.scanHint: Scan the QR code at an event, or tap your staff badge there.

checkin.title: Event check-in
checkin.blockedTitle: You cannot check in to this event
checkin.pendingBody: An event admin will confirm you shortly. This page updates by itself.
checkin.approvedBody: {{points}} points were added to your balance.
checkin.rejectedBody: An event admin declined this check-in. Speak to the event organiser if that looks wrong.
checkin.revertedBody: The points for this event were taken back. Speak to the event organiser for details.
checkin.invalidTitle: This check-in link does not work
checkin.invalidBody: It may have been replaced. Ask the event organiser to show the current QR code.
checkin.codeExpiredBody: The check-in code changes every few seconds. Scan the code on the event screen again.

scanner.title: Scan to check in
scanner.hint: Point the camera at the event’s QR code.
scanner.notCheckIn: That is not a PointHub check-in code. Scan the code shown at the event.
scanner.unsupportedTitle: This browser cannot scan QR codes here
scanner.blockedHint: To scan here, allow camera access for this site in your browser, then try again.
scanner.fallback: Scan the event’s QR code with your phone camera, or tap your staff badge at the event.

gifts.title: Gifts
gifts.subtitle: Exchange your points for something nice.
gifts.mineSubtitle: Every gift you have claimed, and where it stands.
gifts.redeemedBody: Your claim is with the gift team. You can follow it under “My claims”.
gifts.noGifts: No gifts are available at the moment.

host.eventsSubtitle: Create events, hand out points and manage attendance.
host.noEvents: No events yet. Create the first one.

fields.title: Title
fields.pointsHelp: Credited once the check-in is approved.
fields.rosterOnlyHelp: Only people on the imported participant list can check in.

validation.descriptionEnglish: Add an English description as well; it is the fallback for other languages
validation.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start

status.cancelConfirmBody: Nobody will be able to check in. Points that were already awarded stay unless you revert them in the ledger.

qr.title: Check-in link
qr.hint: Show the QR code on a screen or share the link. Employees open it, sign in and tap “Check in”.
qr.alt: QR code to check in to {{title}}
qr.scanPrompt: Scan with your phone camera to check in
qr.regenerateBody: The current link and QR code stop working immediately. Printed or shared copies will need replacing.
qr.notOpen: Check-in is not open. People who scan the code will be told the event is not open.
qr.rotatingHint: Keep this code on a screen in the room. It changes by itself, so only people who are here can scan it.

approvals.approveAllConfirm: Approve every pending check-in and award the points?
approvals.approveRosterConfirm: Approve the pending check-ins of people on the roster and award their points?

station.readyHint: Tap an employee card on the reader
station.notOpen: Open check-in for this event before using the card station.
station.nfcScanning: Hold a card against the back of the phone.
station.nfcDenied: NFC is switched off or permission was denied.
station.cardUidHint: USB readers type here by themselves; you can also enter the UID by hand.

roster.dropTitle: Drop a participant CSV here, or click to choose
roster.dropHint: Columns: employeeNo (required), name, email. UTF-8 with a header row.
roster.rematchHint: Re-match compares the stored roster with today's employee list, which picks up new joiners and leavers.
roster.problemsHint: Unmatched rows cannot be auto-approved. Fix the employee number or email and import again, or re-match once HR has added the person.
roster.noUnmatched: Every row is matched to an employee.

award.title: Award points from this roster
award.hint: For online events, or attendance recorded in another system: import the list of people who completed the event, then give them the points in one go. People who already have their points are skipped, so you can run it again after importing more rows.
award.confirmBody_one: {{count}} person on the roster gets {{points}} points and an email. Their attendance is recorded as “From roster”.
award.confirmBody_other: {{count}} people on the roster get {{points}} points each and an email. Their attendance is recorded as “From roster”.
award.notAllowed: Open the event, or close it once it has ended, to award points from the roster.

reasons.alreadyDecided: check-in was rejected or its points reverted

cardReader.bridgeNoReader: Card bridge connected, but no reader is plugged in
cardReader.bridgeUnavailable: Card bridge not running. Keyboard-wedge readers still work.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Points, participation and what is waiting for you.
dashboard.participationHelp: Employees who checked in during the last 90 days
dashboard.approveAllConfirm: Approve the {{count}} check-ins listed here and award the points?

ledger.title: Point ledger
ledger.subtitle: Every point movement. Nothing is deleted; corrections are new rows.
ledger.search: Search employee, reason, event or gift
ledger.viaApi: Created by another application through an API key
ledger.revertBody: Transaction #{{id}} for {{name}} ({{amount}}) will be cancelled out by a new entry of {{reversal}}.
ledger.reasonRequired: Give a reason. It is kept in the audit log
ledger.amountHelp: Use a negative number to take points away.
ledger.amountNonZero: Enter a number other than zero

gifts.title: Gift management
gifts.subtitle: Catalog, stock and claims.
gifts.disableInfo: The switch enables or disables a gift and is saved at once. A disabled gift disappears from the catalogue and cannot be claimed. Claims already made are not affected: they can still be handed over, cancelled or refunded.
gifts.empty: No gifts yet. Add the first one.

fields.name: Name
fields.perEmployeeLimitHelp: How many of this gift one person may claim in total. Changing the limit only affects new claims; it never cancels claims that already exist.
fields.isActiveHelp: A disabled gift is hidden from the catalogue and cannot be claimed. Claims already made are not affected.

gifts.deltaHelp: Positive to add stock, negative to remove.
gifts.cancelBody: {{name}} gets {{points}} points back and the stock is returned.
gifts.created: Gift created. You can add pictures now.
gifts.newGiftHint: Fill in the details first. Pictures can be added as soon as the gift exists.

limit.required: Enter a number, or choose “No limit”.
limit.invalid: Use a whole number, 1 or more. 0, negative numbers and decimals are not accepted.
limit.tooLarge: The highest limit is {{max}}. For more than that, choose “No limit”.

images.title: Pictures
images.fitHint: Any picture works: it is fitted to the same square frame automatically and nothing is cropped.
images.dropTitle: Drop pictures here, or click to choose
images.dropHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF · up to 8 MB each · {{count}} pictures per gift
images.savedHint: Pictures are saved as soon as you add, move or delete them. Drag a picture to reorder; the first one is the cover.
images.wrongType: Not a supported picture type. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
images.tooLarge: Too large ({{size}} MB). The limit is 8 MB per picture.
images.tooMany: Not uploaded: a gift can have at most {{count}} pictures.
images.deleteBody: The picture is removed from the gift at once. This cannot be undone.
images.deleteCoverBody: This is the cover; the next picture takes its place. This cannot be undone.
images.afterCreate: Create the gift first. The picture upload appears here right afterwards.

employees.title: Employees & cards
employees.subtitle: Balances and the ID cards used for tap check-in.
employees.search: Search by number, name, email or department
employees.scanHint: Tap the card on a reader now, or type the UID printed on it.
employees.removeConfirm: Remove card {{uid}} from {{name}}? It will no longer work for check-in.

apiClients.title: API keys
apiClients.subtitle: Let other applications read balances or move points on behalf of employees.
apiClients.name: Application name
apiClients.nameHelp: Shown in the ledger next to every transaction this key creates.

scopeHelp.pointsRead: Look up balances and transaction history.
scopeHelp.pointsWrite: Add points to and take points from employee balances.
scopeHelp.employeesWrite: Lets the caller add, change and deactivate employees.

apiClients.expiresHelp: Optional. The key stops working after this day.
apiClients.onceTitle: Copy this key now. It is shown only once
apiClients.onceBody: Only a fingerprint of the key is stored. If you lose it, revoke this key and create a new one.
apiClients.revokeBody: “{{name}}” will be rejected immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiClients.howToBody: Send the key in the X-Api-Key header to the endpoints under /api/integration/v1. Give every write an externalReference of your own so a retry never moves points twice.

roles.title: Edit roles
roles.noneSelected: No role ticked: a normal user, who sees their own points, checks in to events and claims gifts.
roles.noneHint: A person can hold several roles. Untick everything to make them a normal user again.
roles.selfWarning: You are removing your own system admin role. After saving you can no longer open this page.

help.systemAdmin: Everything: all events and gifts, the ledger, employees, roles and cards, API keys, seasonal theme, email and the audit log.
help.eventAdmin: Creates and runs events: check-in codes, rosters, approvals and the card station, for the events they run.
help.giftAdmin: Manages gifts, pictures, stock and limits, and marks claims as fulfilled.
help.auditor: Read-only access to the ledger, employees and the audit log.

claims.title: Claims
claims.subtitle: See which gifts still have to be handed over, and mark each claim once it is.

empty.requested: Nothing to hand over. Every claim is taken care of.

claims.reasonHelp: The employee can see this reason under “My claims”.
claims.undoBody: The claim of {{name}} for {{gift}} goes back to “To hand over”. Points and stock stay as they are.
claims.cancelBody: {{name}} claimed {{gift}} × {{quantity}}. Cancelling gives the {{points}} points back to the employee and returns the gift to stock.
claims.cancelled: Claim cancelled. Points and stock were returned.
claims.refundBody: {{name}} received {{gift}} × {{quantity}}. A refund gives the {{points}} points back to the employee and marks the claim as refunded. It cannot be undone.
claims.refundRestockHelp: Untick this if the gift did not come back or cannot be given out again.
claims.refunded: Claim refunded. The points were returned.
claims.refundedRestocked: Claim refunded. The points were returned and the stock restored.
claims.subtitleReadOnly: Every gift claim and where it stands.
claims.readOnly: You can read and export this list. Handing over, cancelling and refunding are done by gift admins.

themes.title: Seasonal theme
themes.subtitle: The look of PointHub follows Taiwan's festival calendar, unless you force one theme.
themes.statusForced: Forced by an administrator. The calendar is ignored.
themes.modeCalendarHelp: Each festival's theme appears for a few days around its date; afterwards the standard look returns. Lunar dates are worked out by the server every year.
themes.modeForcedHelp: Everyone sees the theme you pick, whatever the date, until you switch back.
themes.previewHint: Shows the theme in this browser tab only. Nothing is saved.
themes.previewUnsavedBody: The preview reloads the page, so the changes you have not saved are lost.
themes.previewNoticeBody: Only this browser tab shows it; everyone else sees the active theme. While the preview is on, saving does not change what you see here.
themes.festivalsHelp: Switch a festival off and the calendar skips it: the standard look stays on those days.
themes.festivalsHelpForced: Only used while the theme follows the calendar. Festivals that are switched off are skipped.
themes.defaultHelp: Shown whenever no festival is on.
themes.upcomingHelp: The next twelve months. When two periods overlap, the shorter one wins.

email.title: Email
email.subtitle: The notifications PointHub sends to employees, and how they are delivered.
email.smtpMissing: No mail server is set up, so notifications are skipped instead of sent.
email.smtpAuthYes: Signs in with a user name and password
email.smtpReadOnly: These values come from the server configuration (the Smtp settings in appsettings or environment variables). They cannot be changed on this page.
email.testOk: The mail server accepted the message for {{to}}.
email.testFailed: The mail server did not accept the message
email.queueHelp: Messages are sent in the background and retried when the mail server cannot be reached.
email.selectTemplate: Choose a notification to edit its text.

checkInApproved.name: Check-in approved
checkInApproved.help: Sent when a check-in is approved and the points are added.

checkInRejected.name: Check-in rejected
checkInRejected.help: Sent when an event admin rejects a check-in.

redemptionRequested.name: Claim received
redemptionRequested.help: Sent when an employee claims a gift.

redemptionFulfilled.name: Gift handed over
redemptionFulfilled.help: Sent when a claim is marked as fulfilled.

redemptionCancelled.name: Claim cancelled
redemptionCancelled.help: Sent when a claim is cancelled and the points are returned.

redemptionRefunded.name: Gift refunded
redemptionRefunded.help: Sent when an admin refunds a gift that was already handed over.

pointsAdjusted.name: Points adjusted
pointsAdjusted.help: Sent when an administrator adds or removes points by hand.

email.subject: Subject
email.bodyHelp: Plain text. Leave an empty line between paragraphs; web addresses become links automatically.
email.placeholdersHelp: Click one to insert it at the cursor. In each message it is replaced with the real value.
email.unknownPlaceholder: Unknown placeholder: {{names}}. Use only the ones listed under the message.
email.previewHelp: Rendered by the server with sample values.
email.resetBody: Your own subject and message for {{language}} are deleted and the built-in text is used again.
email.disabledNotice: This notification is switched off, so nobody receives it. You can still edit the text.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.subtitle: Every check-in, across all events. Check-ins are approved on the event’s own page.

lookup.notFound: No employee was found for this link. It may be out of date.
lookup.name: Name
lookup.provisionalHelp: Created at first sign-in and not yet confirmed by the HR system.
lookup.amountPositive: Enter a whole number above zero
lookup.reasonHelp: The employee sees this reason in their own history.
lookup.negativeTitle: The balance will go below zero
lookup.negativeBody: The balance is {{balance}} pts, so it will be {{after}} pts afterwards. That is allowed; just make sure the amount is right.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this at the same moment. Reload and try again.
errors.validation_failed: Some of the values are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.csrf_header_missing: The request was blocked as unsafe. Reload the page and try again.
errors.not_found: That item could not be found.
errors.event_not_open: This event is not open for check-in.
errors.checkin_code_invalid: The check-in code has expired. Scan the code on the event screen again.
errors.already_checked_in: This person has already checked in to the event.
errors.not_on_roster: This event is limited to people on the participant list.
errors.event_full: The event has reached its maximum number of participants.
errors.checkin_already_decided: This check-in was already approved or rejected.
errors.card_not_registered: This card is not registered to anyone.
errors.card_already_registered: This card is already registered to another employee.
errors.invalid_card_uid: That does not look like a card UID.
errors.gift_limit_reached: The per-person limit for this gift has been reached.
errors.gift_inactive: This gift is not available at the moment.
errors.already_reversed: This transaction has already been reverted.
errors.not_reversible: This kind of transaction cannot be reverted.
errors.redemption_already_closed: This claim has changed in the meantime (handed over, cancelled or refunded), so that is no longer possible. Reload to see where it stands.
errors.invalid_csv: The file could not be read. Use a UTF-8 CSV with an employeeNo column.
errors.invalid_image: That file is not a picture we can read, or it is too large (8 MB at most).
errors.too_many_images: A gift can have at most 8 pictures.
errors.last_system_admin: PointHub needs at least one system admin. Give the role to someone else first.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

errorBoundary.title: Something broke on this page
errorBoundary.body: Reloading usually fixes it. If it keeps happening, let the administrators know.

export.truncated: The export stopped at {{max}} rows, so {{file}} does not hold everything. Narrow the filters and export again.
